faqs.q: Sec. 102-277. - Annual inspection program; failure to comply; compliance procedures.
faqs.a:
(a)
Late notice.
If a customer fails to submit an annual inspection report on or before the annual
               inspection due date as required under
section 102-276
(e), the director shall, within 28 days of the annual inspection due date, send a
               late notice to the customer.
(1)
Contents.
The late notice shall contain a notice that a late fee in an amount set forth in
               the utilities administrative fees and costs schedule will be added to the water bill
               for the property. In the case of a property that is owned by one individual, one or
               more individuals, or a business entity, but which contains more than one assembly,
               the late fee will be assessed against each assembly on the property and otherwise
               as set forth in the utilities administrative fees and costs schedule. The late notice
               shall remind the customer and property owner of the obligation to comply with the
               annual inspection requirement, order them to submit a completed, valid inspection
               report to the director within 28 days of the date of the late notice, and state that
               fees, charges, and other penalties will continue to be assessed if the inspection
               report is not submitted as required.
(b)
First violation notice.
If a customer fails to submit an inspection report within 28 days of the date of
               the late notice, the director shall, within 35 days of the date of the late notice,
               send a first violation notice to the customer.
(1)
Contents.
The first violation notice shall contain a notice that a charge in an amount set
               forth in the utilities administrative fees and costs schedule will be added to the
               water bill for the property as a civil charge. In the case of a property that is owned
               by one individual, one or more individuals, or a business entity, but which contains
               more than one assembly, the civil charge will be assessed against each assembly on
               the property and otherwise as set forth in the utilities administrative fees and costs
               schedule. If the customer or property owner provides proof of compliance with the
               annual inspection program within 14 days of the date of the first violation notice,
               the director shall waive one-half of the civil charge assessed under this subsection
               (b). The notice shall also remind the customer and property owner of the obligation
               to comply with the annual inspection requirement, order them to submit a completed
               valid inspection report to the director within 28 days of the date of the first violation
               notice, and state that additional fees, charges, and other penalties will be assessed
               if the report is not submitted as required.
(c)
Second violation notice.
If a customer fails to submit an inspection report within 28 days of the date of
               the first violation notice, the director shall, within 35 days of the date of the
               first violation notice, send a second violation notice to the customer.
(1)
Contents.
The second violation notice shall contain a notice that a charge in an amount set
               forth in the utilities administrative fees and costs schedule will be added to the
               water bill for the property as a civil charge. In the case of a property that is owned
               by one individual, one or more individuals, or a business entity, but which contains
               more than one assembly, the civil charge will be assessed against each assembly on
               the property and otherwise as set forth in the utilities administrative fees and costs
               schedule. If the customer or property owner provides proof of compliance with the
               annual inspection program within 14 days of the date of the second violation notice,
               the director shall waive one-fourth of the civil charge assessed under this subsection
               (c). The notice shall also remind the customer and property owner of the obligation
               to comply with the annual inspection requirement, and notify them that service will
               be terminated in accordance with the provisions of this article if the report is not
               submitted as required.
(d)
Termination notice.
If a customer fails to submit an inspection report within 21 days of date of the
               second violation notice, the director shall send a notice of termination of service
               to the customer. The termination notice shall also contain a notice that a water shut-off,
               restoration, and other fees and costs as set forth in the utilities administrative
               fees and costs schedule will be assessed against the property as applicable. Water
               service shall be terminated no sooner than seven days after the date of the termination
               notice, and shall remain terminated until such time as the property is brought into
               compliance with the requirements of the annual inspection program.
(e)
Mailing and posting of notices.
Each late notice, violation notice, or termination notice issued under this section
               shall be mailed to the customer by first class U.S. Mail. In addition, a termination
               notice shall be posted on the property. In the event that the property owner is different
               than the customer, the late notice, violation notice, and termination notice shall
               also be mailed to the listed owner, at the address on file with the applicable county
               tax assessor's office. Each notice must state any appeal available. The city's inability
               to comport strictly with the time deadlines set forth herein for the mailing or posting
               of any late notice, violation notice, or termination notice shall not impact the enforcement
               action.
(f)
Other actions authorized.
Nothing in this section is intended to limit the duties and powers of the director
               as set forth in
section 102-275
. The director may, at any time after a customer fails to submit an inspection report
               in accordance with the requirements of subsection
102-276
(e), and in addition to the actions described in this section, take any other action
               authorized by this article, including issuing a summons and complaint.
(
Ord. No. 4829
, § 1, 12-5-2022)
